messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: multiple clusters reporting p99 latency SLO breach for streaming responses in us-west-2. auto-pager sent to #eng-oncall. severity: sev2.

alex_dev: seeing it too — p95 ~400ms -> p95 ~2.1s, p99 ~6-12s on streaming endpoints. spikes started ~00:12UTC. errors low, but heavy stalls during tail token fetch.

sam_sre: attaching quick metrics dump: `kv_cache_evictions: 820/s`, `prefill_requests: 3.1k/s`, `decode_ops_busy: 92%`, `streaming_stalls: 4.8%` over last 5m. looks like KV pressure + decode backpressure.

tori_infra: noticed slab fragmentation on shard 14/22, free-able pages dropping. eviction churn high. prefill tasks outrunning decode workers causing long tail while waiting on KV fetch.

alex_dev: impact: a subset of customers on gen-streaming routes seeing stalled tokens and timeouts. CS flagged 2 large tenants reporting degraded UX.

jason_prod: @lee_cs can you DM which tenants? we may need to SR workaround (fallback to sync gen)

lee_cs: DM sent with tenant ids. they confirm intermittent stalls, willing to accept short fallback. they want ETA and mitigation plan.

sam_sre: quick mitigation proposal: 1) throttle prefill concurrency by 30% 2) temporarily increase decode worker pool on affected nodes 3) enable eviction-rate-limit to reduce churn 4) route high-latency streaming traffic to fallback model variant in us-east-1.

alex_dev: agree. prioritize throttle prefill + bump decode. do we have a safe API for prefill throttle?

tori_infra: yes — run: ```
# reduce prefill concurrency by 30% on shard group 14
rb config set prefill.concurrency --group shard-14 --factor 0.7
# increase decode workers by 2 on pool streaming-decode-usw2
rb pool scale streaming-decode-usw2 --add 2
```

sam_sre: also enabling eviction limiter: `rb cache set eviction.rate_limit=500/s --shard shard-14` — this reduces churn and lets decode catch up. will monitor eviction queue length.

jason_prod: I'm going to open a short-lived canary: route 10% of streaming sessions to fallback-smallmodel in us-east-1. command: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/route -d '{"selector":"streaming-usw2","fallback":"fallback-smallmodel","pct":10}'`

alex_dev: starting throttle now. applying config...

incident-bot: ACTION: prefill throttle change deployed by alex_dev at 7923456795.

alex_dev: prefill concurrency down 30% on shard-14. observing immediate drop in prefill requests to ~2.1k/s. decode worker bump in progress.

sam_sre: decode pool scaled +2 workers on all nodes in streaming-decode-usw2. decode queue length falling from 820 -> 350 requests in 2m. p95 now ~650ms.

tori_infra: eviction rate reduced to ~460/s after limiter. slab defragmentation tasks queued but will take longer.

jason_prod: routing canary live (10%) to fallback-smallmodel us-east-1. early signs: canary sessions show no streaming stalls, end-to-end latencies ~300-500ms.

lee_cs: informed the affected tenants. they asked for ETA — what should I say?

alex_dev: say we have a mitigation in place, stalls reduced, full recovery expected within 30-45 minutes while we let decode catch up and slab defrag runs. escalate if anything degrades.

sam_sre: running short-term telemetry checks: `query: sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions[1m])) by (shard)`, `query: histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(streaming_latency_bucket[5m]))` — keeping an eye on tail.

incident-bot: NOTE: p99 streaming latency decreased from 11.8s -> 2.6s since mitigation started. p95 now below SLO (SLO=1s) but still recovering.

tori_infra: starting manual slab compaction on shard-14 (non-blocking). command: `rb cache compaction --shard shard-14 --mode incremental`. will take ~20-40m.

sam_sre: planning followups: 1) automated prefill-adaptive throttling based on decode queue 2) longer-term: add soft reservation for decode ops + prioritized streaming tokens 3) improve cache compaction heuristics to avoid fragmentation waves.

alex_dev: adding runbook note: if p99 > 3s after 45m, escalate to infra oncall and consider full route failover to other region.

jason_prod: postmortem owners? propose sam_sre + tori_infra + alex_dev. include customer impact timeline and config diffs.

lee_cs: tenants thanked the team; will follow up with pro forma incident email and log snippets.

incident-bot: HANDOFF: oncall switching at 7923456820 to sam_sre for monitoring/cleanup. next update expected in 15m.

sam_sre: taking handoff. will post a summary of metrics and next steps after compaction completes.

alex_dev: nice quick coordination. leaving this thread to sam for closure. :thumbsup:

sam_sre: (later) compaction progress: 40% done, eviction rate steady ~420/s, p99 ~1.3s, streaming stall rate down to 0.6%. preparing postmortem draft.

sam_sre: (final) cluster health restored to baseline. closing incident. root cause preliminary: KV slab fragmentation + unbalanced prefill->decode pipeline causing transient bursts of eviction + decode backlog. mitigation: throttle prefill, eviction limiter, decode pool scale, incremental compaction, canary routing. follow-up action items tracked in RFC-345.
